name: Post Graduate Scholarship for Ph.D./LLM Students
benefit: **Financial Assistance:** Scholarship is provided to the poor students to help them achieve the benefits of Higher Education. **Mode of Disbursement:** Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) _*The applicant must maintain registration as Doctor of Philosophy/Post Doctorate Research Scholar in recognized universities._ _*Academic performance standards must be maintained as per university requirements._
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must have registered their names as Doctor of Philosophy/Post Doctorate Research Scholar in any recognized universities. - The applicant must be domiciled in Assam. - The applicant must have obtained at least 55% or above marks in the last qualifying examination. - The applicant must have uniformly good academic records.
